# JeffreyAiFudenna Portfolio

> Jeffrey's AI projects, each one finished and written up. Plain HTML, no build step. Hosted at https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/

I'm looking for my next role. This site is the work: websites that publish themselves, a city data aggregator, an AI job-search pipeline, AI video and images, and a short story drafted with AI. Two of the builds run on their own every morning.

## Projects

- [The Infinite Buddha](https://www.theinfinitebuddha.xyz): A website that makes and publishes new Buddha art every day. Python asks Gemini for the image, GitHub Actions runs it daily, Vercel redeploys. Live.
- [Fremont by the Numbers](https://fremontcabythenumbers.com): A data aggregator for Fremont, California. Public figures on housing, schools, safety, jobs, parks and startups, with the source and date under every number. Built with Claude. Live.
- [Daily AI News](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/news.html): A scheduled Claude task finds the day's biggest AI stories, checks every link, writes a plain-English summary and a "why it matters" line, and publishes the digest every morning. Data: https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/news/stories.json. RSS: https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/news/feed.xml
- [AI Job Search Pipeline](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/jobsearch.html): Claude ran a team of 37 AI agents that found, double-checked and ranked 829 job listings in under a day. A Python script scores each role 0-100, a separate audit fixed 73 scores and removed 20 listings.
- Cool Moves Reel: Short Viggle clips cut into a reel. In the blog.
- Remixed photos with AI: Camping photos re-imagined with Gemini, next to the real picture. In the blog.
- Family Tree Website: Private, password-protected, with edit history. No public link.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/): Write-ups and stories made with AI.
- [Why random apps kept showing up on my Samsung phone](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/samsung-hidden-app-installer.html): A hidden installer, apparently linked to the carrier, was adding apps to a Galaxy S23. How Claude helped find and remove it. Nov 2026.
- [11:11, a science fiction short story](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/11-11.html): Every night at 11:11 the lights go out worldwide, and nobody makes us. Drafted with AI, with notes on what changed.
- [Cool Moves Reel](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/cool-moves-reel.html): Short Viggle clips that put me in scenes I couldn't film. Oct 2026.
- [Remixed photos with AI](https://jeffrey-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/blog/ai-photo-remix.html): A camping photo remixed with Gemini, next to the real picture. Oct 2026.

## About this site

Plain HTML pages plus a small blog folder, one shared theme stylesheet, no framework. Written in Claude Code. Twelve color themes plus holiday accents computed from the Gregorian, Hebrew and Chinese calendars. Structured data in JSON-LD. This file exists so agents can read the site as easily as people do.
